name: Whitelake Frostfeather
desc: A longsword light as the feathers of a snow swan, and which stays pure and untainted at all times.

value.text: When the equipping character hits an opponent with their Elemental Skill, they gain "Lake-Hued Lament": ATK increases by <color=#36ffff>8%/10%/12%/14%/16%</color> for 8s. This effect can trigger once every 0.1s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is independent. At 3 stacks, the CRIT DMG of any Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG caused by the equipping character is increased by <color=#36ffff>50%/65%/80%/95%/110%</color> , and triggering Stellar Glimmer reactions or Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG will also restore <color=#36ffff>4/4.5/5/5.5/6</color> Elemental Energy to the character. This Energy recovery effect can trigger once every 3.5s. Can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.

customize.name: Whitelake Frostfeather
customize.desc: A longsword light as the feathers of a snow swan, and which stays pure and untainted at all times.

customize.name: Crimson Moon’s Semblance
customize.desc: A keen-edged weapon, luster dazzling as the crimson moon. It is said that an ancient dynasty once regarded it as a ritual object that could bridge two worlds, but none still remember the beliefs and ceremonies of that bygone age.

customize.name: Rust
customize.desc: A completely rusted iron greatbow. The average person would lack the strength to even lift it, let alone fire it.

customize.name: Favonius Sword
customize.desc: A standard-issue longsword of the Knights of Favonius. When you're armed with this agile and sharp weapon, channeling the power of the elements has never been so easy!

customize.name: Sacrificial Fragments
customize.desc: A weathered script, the text of which is no longer legible. A cursed item eroded by the winds of time.

customize.name: Dragon's Bane
customize.desc: A polearm decorated with an entwining golden dragon. Light and sharp, this weapon may very well kill dragons with ease.

customize.name: The Bell
customize.desc: A heavy greatsword. A clock is embedded within it, though its internal mechanisms have long been damaged.

desc.text:
...
As the academic world has acknowledged, the script for "Black Snow Swan" is based not only on an original story but also references some folk songs, manuscripts, and other scripts preceding the creation of the Korolevskiy Troupe.
The following two scripts are from the Palestar Songbook, which precedes the present day by around 300 years. Their lines, tone, rhythm, and even sentences are almost identical, and it is impossible to tell which was written first. In the second act of "Black Snow Swan," the white snow swan Tatiana's final dance is adapted from one of these passages, with the removal of a sword dance that has nothing to do with ballet (but which commonly appears in ancient fae theater). The original text is published exactly as it is, to ensure complete accuracy and authenticity.
...
"White"
...
Passage Summary: The Elfking tempts the young woman Tatiana, who has resolved to elope, to murder her lover.
...
Tatiana: See you now, my father, the Elfking of renown?
Tatiana: The beautiful Elfking, with robe and crown.
Tatiana's Father: My daughter, you see naught but the futile wind.
Tatiana's Father: Cold it be, but not as human hearts unkind.
Tatiana: My father, my father, can you not now hear?
Tatiana: The promises the fair Elfking breathes into mine ear?
Tatiana's Father: My daughter, you hear the voice that snow and breeze begot.
Tatiana's Father: Though cold, it bites not quite so nigh as benefits forgot.
Elfking: Such is man, cold-hearted, forgetting favors received.
Elfking: As you are also, lovely Tatiana,
Elfking: Who for your beloved shall abandon your father.
Tatiana: But not my heart, unlike you, venom'd snake, who lavish attention equally to all.
Tatiana: For though you wait upon them so, in the end you shall bite their ankles. I will not heed your lies.
Tatiana: Yes, I shall elope with my beloved. If you will, report me and my cause aright to my father,
Tatiana: And let the rest be silence. Slay me with your sword, if it pleases you!
Elfking: Wondrous imagination! Yet to feel fate's cruelty most acutely thereby is to nurse a festering wound.
Elfking: You yearn for beautiful sentiment, for pure love, for you have yet to taste its fragrance.
Elfking: But say I to you that this stage, though huge, is but a scene in a play. The heavens have long arranged all.
Elfking: Once the oath is broken, the skies shall forever be shut. Our lot shall be to struggle and sink within this filthy sludge.
Elfking: The bird that should once have belonged in the sky shall have its wings broken, and shall fall to the sullied soil. Is this what you wish for?
Tatiana: And what would you know of that?
Elfking: That even now, your heart wavers?
Elfking: I am you. I know as a matter of course.
Tatiana: And what would you have me do?
Elfking: Ah, you love him, do you not?
Elfking: Love is like a blade that pierces your heart. Will his promise today stand tomorrow?
Elfking: See! This sword is purer than his lies. A fine blade, but alas, without a scabbard.
Tatiana: You wish for me to...
Elfking: Ah! Did I ever say such terrible words? And from whose mouth should I expect thanks?
Elfking: I swear now upon my reputation that I meant only to present you this lovely sword, no more, no less.
...

In the second act of "Black Snow Swan," the white snow swan Tatiana's final dance is adapted from one of these passages, with the removal of a sword dance that has nothing to do with ballet (but which commonly appears in ancient fae theater). The original text is published exactly as it is, to ensure complete accuracy and authenticity.
...
"Black"
...
Passage Summary: By the lake, an envoy from the south seeks to persuade the Rusalka Vaselisa, who has resolved to leave her homeland, to murder her new liege.
...
Vaselisa: See you now, my father, that envoy of renown?
Vaselisa: The beautiful envoy, with robe and crown.
Vaselisa's Father: My daughter, you see naught but the futile wind.
Vaselisa's Father: Cold it be, but not as human hearts unkind.
Vaselisa: My father, my father, can you not now hear?
Vaselisa: The promises the fair envoy breathes into mine ear?
Vaselisa's Father: My daughter, you hear the voice that snow and breeze begot.
Vaselisa's Father: Though cold, it bites not quite so nigh as benefits forgot.
Envoy: Such is man, cold-hearted, forgetting favors received.
Envoy: Such as you, pitiable Vaselisa,
Envoy: Who for your new liege shall abandon your father.
Vaselisa: I do this for my kin, unlike you, venom'd snake, who lavish attention equally to all.
Vaselisa: For though you wait upon them so, in the end you shall bite their ankles. I will not heed your lies.
Vaselisa: Yes, I shall serve that loving liege. If you will, report me and my cause aright to my father,
Vaselisa: And let the rest be silence. Slay me with your sword, if it pleases you!
Envoy: Wondrous imagination! Yet to feel fate's cruelty most acutely thereby is to nurse a festering wound.
Envoy: You yearn for the loving one's order, believing that he can protect your kin, and yet you do not perceive the poisonous cunning in his words.
Envoy: Have his retainers not plotted against your people, plunging them into Fire-Water?
Envoy: Rather than kneel and become a slave, why not rule? Or do you wish to break your own wings to achieve your purposes?
Vaselisa: And what would you know of that?
Envoy: That even now, your heart wavers?
Envoy: We are both fae. Surely I know.
Vaselisa: And what would you have me do?
Envoy: Ah! Does your new liege not proclaim himself to be of "love"?
Envoy: He trusts you, just as he trusts all his brothers and sisters.
Envoy: Trust is ever so sharp, like this pristine longsword.
Envoy: My liege forged this in person. A fine blade, but alas, without a scabbard.
Vaselisa: You wish for me to...
Envoy: Ah! Did I ever say such terrible words? And from whose mouth should I expect thanks?
Envoy: I swear now upon my liege's reputation that I meant only to present you this lovely sword, no more, no less.
...

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Measured Pour of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The radiance that once gleamed like the aurora in the northernmost sky was extinguished when it met the gaze from high above.
The calamity of bitter cold and black crystal nearly destroyed the foundations upon which all life endured.
Only the fae, unafraid of the cold, were able to emerge from the ice and snow to rule over the deserted realm.

materials.name: Hollow Root of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
With only a few crystals grown upon it, this branch holds little power and gives off a faint glow.

materials.name: Chimeric Core
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
This is the most fundamental core grown within a man-made monster. Yet, simple as it may be, it contains the primordial design for the growth of all man-made creations.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Intoxication of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
What others enjoy as a festive indulgence after a bountiful grain harvest is a necessity of survival for the clans who walk through the bitter cold.
It is said that the Domovoy, whose mastery of brewing was without equal, once relied on this art to enrich the treasury of the king they served.
And so, passed from clan to clan through trade, the fae's brew flowed across the frozen lands like honey laced with poison.

materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch bearing a fair number of crystals. It feels heavy in the hand, and traces of vitality can still be felt within it even after it has broken away from the Leshy's body.

materials.name: Symbiotic Chimeric Nucleus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
A relatively complex core harvested from a man-made monster. This symbiotic nucleus is engineered to sustain the biological cycles of two distinct life-forms, seamlessly weaving them into a single organism.

materials.name: Exhilaration of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Legend has it that long ago, countless casks of fine wine were poured into a frozen lake.
Some say the wine was intended as wartime provisions, which had to be destroyed after some mishap. Others say a certain Grand Duke of the Domovoy had lost a bet to the ruler of the Water Imps.
Only when unquenchable azure hellflame spread across the lake, and the foes below writhed in choking waves, did they come to understand:
In the hands of the people well versed in the turning of the world, water itself could burn, and even the sweetest nectar could prove deadlier than poison.

materials.name: Coiled Core of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch with a fully formed crystal core. It contains vitality that will not easily fade. If buried in the soil, it would likely grow into a new Leshy before long.

materials.name: Prime Chimeric Nexus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
The most complex core a man-made monster can possibly sustain, serving as an artificially engineered yet flawless seed of life. Whoever brought this creation into life has surely unlocked the very secrets of how life itself is shaped.

materials.name: Revelry of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The Grand Duke of the Domovoy commanded the crystal mines and the development of the frozen lands. To him, carving an oasis out of the polar wastes was a mere trifle, and importing rye of better quality was no difficult task either.
Even among the many fae nobles who had endured in Snezhnaya to this day, none could rival the splendor of his status.
Yet the flame of ambition burned ever brighter, licking its way down his throat, while the ancient fae's greed swelled with the years and knew no end.
